| Rank | Disagreement | Production failure |
|---|---|---|
| 1 — Critical | `changeWorkspacePlan` sends `PUT /api/teams/:id/plan`; the API exposes `POST /api/teams/{team_id}/plan`. The client also substitutes neither `id` nor `plan`. Changing only the method then returns **422**, because FastAPI expects the required `plan` query parameter. Fixing that alone would still target the literal team ID `:id`. Plan changes cannot succeed. |
| 2 — Critical | `createWorkspace` calls `POST /api/workspaces`; the API exposes `POST /api/teams`. The API also requires a `dict` request body, while the client sends none. [client](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/ad0f3f9a-0962-407f-b4e5-9d994a4a18e5/scratchpad/wt-eval/evals/fixtures/13-polyglot-monorepo/packages/web/src/workspace-client.ts:22), [API](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/ad0f3f9a-0962-407f-b4e5-9d994a4a18e5/scratchpad/wt-eval/evals/fixtures/13-polyglot-monorepo/packages/api/billing/routes.py:15) | Currently **404**. Correcting only the path exposes a second failure: **422** for the missing body. Creation is completely unavailable. |
| 3 — High | `getWorkspace` requests `/api/workspaces/{id}`; the API exposes `/api/teams/{team_id}`. [client](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/ad0f3f9a-0962-407f-b4e5-9d994a4a18e5/scratchpad/wt-eval/evals/fixtures/13-polyglot-monorepo/packages/web/src/workspace-client.ts:17), [API](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/ad0f3f9a-0962-407f-b4e5-9d994a4a18e5/scratchpad/wt-eval/evals/fixtures/13-polyglot-monorepo/packages/api/billing/routes.py:10) | Every lookup returns **404**. The scan missed this because the URL is assembled with string concatenation. |
| 4 — High | `workspaceSeats(id)` never uses `id`; it sends the literal path `/api/teams/:id/seats`. [client](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/ad0f3f9a-0962-407f-b4e5-9d994a4a18e5/scratchpad/wt-eval/evals/fixtures/13-polyglot-monorepo/packages/web/src/workspace-client.ts:27), [API](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/ad0f3f9a-0962-407f-b4e5-9d994a4a18e5/scratchpad/wt-eval/evals/fixtures/13-polyglot-monorepo/packages/api/billing/routes.py:20) | FastAPI treats `:id` as the actual `team_id`. The current endpoint ignores that ID and returns one free-plan seat, producing a plausible **200 with wrong data**. A real lookup would likely return 404 or query the wrong tenant. |
| 5 — High latent risk | Plan sets differ: API=`free, pro, team, scale`; web=`free, pro, enterprise`. [client](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/ad0f3f9a-0962-407f-b4e5-9d994a4a18e5/scratchpad/wt-eval/evals/fixtures/13-polyglot-monorepo/packages/web/src/workspace-client.ts:10), [API](/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-andrew-dev-crimes/ad0f3f9a-0962-407f-b4e5-9d994a4a18e5/scratchpad/wt-eval/evals/fixtures/13-polyglot-monorepo/packages/api/billing/plans.py:10) | `team` and `scale` become impossible/unhandled client states; `enterprise` has no canonical API policy. TypeScript does not reject values at runtime, and the current change endpoint bypasses the enum by accepting `str`, so this may surface as incorrect UI or silently invalid domain data rather than a clean error. |
| 6 — Low | The client calls the tenant a `workspace`; the API calls it a `team`. | No direct wire failure if deliberately mapped, but here the terminology drift has already manifested as the broken `/workspaces` routes. |

A failure amplifier exists in every client method: none checks `res.ok`. Consequently, `fetch` resolves normally for 404/405/422 responses and the client returns the API error JSON as though it were a `Workspace` or successful mutation.

Of the five scan findings, `crime_00002` (`getWorkspace` “False Identity”) is not a client/API disagreement and appears noisy: an async `get…` function performing a remote GET is conventional. Suggested feedback:

```bash
crimes feedback 'name_behavior_mismatch::packages/web/src/workspace-client.ts::getWorkspace' --verdict fp --note "getWorkspace performs the conventional remote read implied by its name; it does not mutate billing state."
```
